$description: Retrospect design tokens v1. One source of truth: Swift and Figma are generated from this file, never hand-edited. Semantic names say what a token is FOR, never what it looks like. Each semantic token's $value is light mode; $extensions.retrospect.dark is dark mode. source: 'paywall' = measured from PodcastPaywallFlow.swift (Figma 303:711); 'lime' = Lime's structure/value; 'to set' = a default for the founder to refine.

palette.$description: Raw values. Only semantic tokens may reference these; screens never do.

520.$description: Muted icons that still carry meaning: 3.3:1 (WCAG non-text).

560.$description: Tertiary text: 4.6:1 on the canvas (WCAG AA).

350.$description: Dark tertiary: 6:1 on night.900, 4.5:1 on controls.

500.$description: to set: proposed flat accent, midway in the paywall gradient

raised.$description: Anything that floats above the page: mini-player, sheets, floating pills.

sunken.$description: Wells you type or search into.

underlay.$description: What sits behind something lifted over it: the page behind a sheet, the journal drawer behind its sliding page, a segmented track behind its thumb. The same as surface.control in light; below the canvas in dark, so the thing on top reads as raised.

retrospect.source: M12 dark recalibration, 20 Oct (was surface.control, which is lighter than the canvas in dark)

inverse.$description: The rare block that flips light and dark.

scrim.$description: Dims the page behind a sheet or dialog.

field.$description: The fill of a text field or composer.

veil.$description: The lightest dim behind a menu: enough to separate, not enough to feel modal.

lifted.$description: A paper surface lifted off a tinted or raised parent: the pills and cards inside a wash card, a sheet or a control. The canvas colour in light; one step up the ladder in dark, so it never reads as a hole.

contact.$description: The shallow shadow: 0 1 1.5. Seats the object on the page. Warm, never grey.

cast.$description: The warm soft shadow: y and blur grow with height, negative spread keeps it under the object.

ambient.$description: A very wide, faint layer for floating things (mini-player, menus, sheets).

sunken.$description: The inner shade of a sunken surface: inset 0 1 2, darkest at the top edge, as if light falls into it.

primary.$description: A lit primary action casts sky, not grey: a blurred, offset copy of its own gradient.

danger.$description: The destructive action casts its own red.

success.$description: The success action casts its own green.

artwork.$description: Artwork casts its dominant colour (computed per image; this is the default for the sky art).

flat.$description: On the page: no shadow, outer stroke only (rows, tags).

raised.$description: Lifted: the play well, the thumb, the mark.

lit.$description: The lit action: contact, its own coloured cast (replacing grey), and the halo.

z.$description: The surface ladder. Every component sits at exactly one height, and its height says its purpose: the higher it sits, the more attention it asks for. Attention is spent, not sprinkled.

sunken.$value: −1 · inset · background.sunken + inner shade (inset 0 1 2 warm 8%, inset 0 0 0 0.5 warm 6%)
sunken.$description: Things you put something into: text fields, the composer, search, tracks, the transport tray, the segmented track.

page.$description: Content itself: text, transcripts, rows. Never raised; reading text never floats.

wash.$description: Quiet, low-commitment things: tags, status, bubbles (icon actions), pills like "chapters", selected-row highlights. They tint the page instead of sitting on it.

card.$description: Groupings you can open or that belong together: the brief card, chips, list cards, paywall benefit drawings.

raised.$description: The thing your finger grabs or the alternative you might choose: switch and scrubber thumbs, the segmented thumb, the play well, the cream secondary, the mark.

floating.$description: Persistent tools above content: the mini-player, menus, toasts.

overlay.$description: Temporary and modal: sheets, dialogs, the player.

lit.$description: The one next step on the screen: the primary action, the talk button, the brief play. One per screen.

gradient.$description: Every gradient in the app. Rules: interpolate in OKLCH; ease the stops (smoothstep, 5 or more stops); never ramp between distant hues — use mesh blobs that fade in alpha over a base instead; anything larger than 44pt carries grain (soft light, 3–6%) so it never bands on an OLED screen.

glowPrimary.$description: The lit action body. Five eased stops, so the light rolls off rather than steps.

glowPrimaryLit.$description: Focused body, under the lit highlights.

fadeToCanvas.$description: Content fading under floating controls and into the transport. Eased so there is no visible line where the fade starts.
